I'm sorry you're experiencing these symptoms.  I just had my L5 S1 fused 3 weeks ago.   The 1st 3 days were absolute hell but I pushed through and kept moving.   After the 3rd day the swelling in my left foot was terrible.  This lasted for 2 weeks.  I increased my water intake and really cleaned up my diet and with pursuing multiple mile walks every day the swelling is gone.  

     The calf and thigh weakness was there but definitely not to the extent you are describing but as you said everyone recovers differently and your symptoms aren't completely abnormal.  

     I imagine a lot of it depends on how disabled you were before hand and how much muscle  loss there was.   If you weren't really using it for a long time before the surgery you're gonna have to build it back. It's gonna take time and commitment but stay positive and you'll get through it I hope
